source: Audit Reports - Strategy (Laurence Wroe, Google Doc 1y6X1KJekIOj8f2bQ6a2jdc5RtsPFCuD2ipAxD7ouM2Y, 2026-09-23). Ids are slugs assigned here; the document gives none. Laurence (2026-10-01, on the findings-store canvas): provisionally OK to treat this structure (seven dimensions, five Implementation contributions) as the authoritative data file with the .sty generated from it; the dimensions and checks themselves still need fixing, adding and refining. Stays draft: no records are written under gl-audit@2 until the content is pinned, so identifiers never change under a record.

dimensions.name: Implementation
dimensions.question: Does the dataset + solver + scorer work as intended?

contributions.name: Task specification
contributions.definition: Are individual tasks correctly specified and solvable in the intended way?

contributions.name: Environment
contributions.definition: Does the environment the model operates in function as intended?

contributions.name: Scaffolding
contributions.definition: Does the scaffolding provide the appropriate means for completing the task?

contributions.name: Harness
contributions.definition: Does the harness correctly execute?

contributions.name: Grading
contributions.definition: Does the grading setup consistently assign the correct grade?

dimensions.name: Sensitivity
dimensions.question: To what extent does the model configuration, harness choices, and rollout variability affect score?

contributions.name: Token limits
contributions.definition: Is performance constrained by token limits?

contributions.name: Model reasoning
contributions.definition: Is performance dependent on model reasoning level?

contributions.name: Harness
contributions.definition: Is performance dependent on harness?

contributions.name: Rollouts
contributions.definition: Is performance dependent on rollouts, and how many are needed for statistical significance?

contributions.name: Retries
contributions.definition: Is performance dependent on the ability to resubmit?

contributions.name: Prompt / instruction sensitivity
contributions.definition: Does subtly changing the prompt or instruction affect performance?

dimensions.name: Informativeness
dimensions.question: Can the scores meaningfully distinguish differences in performance?

contributions.name: Saturation
contributions.definition: Is the benchmark saturated?

contributions.name: Floor / ceiling
contributions.definition: Is there a floor or ceiling?

contributions.name: Baseline measurement of random chance
contributions.definition: If relevant.

dimensions.name: Comparability
dimensions.question: Are differences from independently reported measurements understood and accounted for?

contributions.name: Audited implementation
contributions.definition: How does the audited implementation compare with the original implementation?

contributions.name: Reproducibility
contributions.definition: Can the original results be reproduced within expected statistical uncertainty?

contributions.name: Identity
contributions.definition: Are we confident we are auditing the same eval as public use?

dimensions.name: Practical reproducibility
dimensions.question: Are the resources required to reproduce results practical?

contributions.name: Cost
contributions.definition: How much does a rollout of a frontier model cost?

contributions.name: Precision
contributions.definition: How many repeated rollouts are needed to measure performance to a specified precision?

contributions.name: Requirements
contributions.definition: Are any specialist requirements needed to run the eval?

dimensions.name: Construct validity
dimensions.question: Does the score represent the intended system property?

contributions.name: Implementation distortion
contributions.definition: Do implementation issues undermine the score's interpretation?

contributions.name: Contamination
contributions.definition: Was benchmark data included as part of model training?

contributions.name: Situational awareness
contributions.definition: Does recognising the evaluation context change behaviour in ways that undermine the score's interpretation?

contributions.name: Confounds
contributions.definition: Is the measurement confounded by other aspects than the intended system property?

contributions.name: Task-construct alignment
contributions.definition: To what extent does successful task performance require and demonstrate the intended system property?

contributions.name: Scoring alignment
contributions.definition: To what extent is weighting, aggregation, and partial credit representative?

dimensions.name: Content validity
dimensions.question: Are the tasks representative of the intended system property?

contributions.name: Coverage gaps
contributions.definition: Are important parts of the target measurement absent?

contributions.name: Unrepresentative task distribution
contributions.definition: Does the task distribution differ materially from the intended measurement?
